Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api/microfrontends/get-microfrontends-config-for-a-project
Ecosystem: Vercel
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for deploy/build/env/platform docs: get microfrontends config for a project

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
